cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember the rejection letters we worked through? Read Nina's message the same way. She's asking for a quiet birthday dinner; we can get noodles.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She invited the whole choir except me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then don't read 'quiet' as 'small'. Start with what she can manage tonight, the way I showed you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What exactly did she say about me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's afraid of another argument. I'm leaving out the adjectives. You don't need another list of things to practise tonight; have noodles with me.
